title: Execution after shifting gate references
statement: Let $x$ be an assignment to the inputs, and let $g$ and $h$ be finite lists of arithmetic gates. If every gate reference in $h$ is shifted forward by the length of $g$, then executing the concatenated list yields the values from executing $g$, followed by the values from executing $h$: $\operatorname{run}(x,g\mathbin{+} \operatorname{shift}_{|g|}(h))=\operatorname{run}(x,g)\mathbin{+}\operatorname{run}(x,h)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ and $h$ are finite lists of gates
